name: independent-discovery

steps.action: Discovery: the Entity destination leads to Help, which lists all four guides for this reader
steps.actual: The Entities destination offered a Help link, and the Help index headed "Guides for Legal Team Member" listed all four Entity guides by their exact titles

steps.action: Discovery: searching each exact title finds its guide
steps.actual: Each exact title was found by the Help search and resolved to its own article (Maintain Entities and Counterparties -> /help/entities-and-counterparties; Manage Holdings, Officers, and Registrations -> /help/entity-records; Track and file Entity obligations -> /help/entity-obligations; Manage Entity structure and access -> /help/entity-structure-and-access)

steps.action: Discovery: an outline link moves the reader to the section and focuses its heading
steps.actual: Selecting "Read the calendar and Home" moved to #read-the-calendar-and-home; the focused element was H2#read-the-calendar-and-home and the section heading was in view

steps.action: Discovery: the article links out to the same guide in the formal reader
steps.actual: "Read this article in the full documentation" opened /documentation/entity-structure-and-access and showed the same guide, "Manage Entity structure and access", in the formal reader

steps.action: Discovery: the Help article holds at 320, 720 and 1440 CSS pixels in Light, Dark and Warm
steps.actual: The Help article kept its title and produced no horizontal overflow in every theme and width combination (light@320px:0px, light@720px:0px, light@1440px:0px, dark@320px:0px, dark@720px:0px, dark@1440px:0px, warm@320px:0px, warm@720px:0px, warm@1440px:0px)

steps.action: Discovery: the Help article holds at an emulated 200 percent zoom
steps.actual: At an emulated 200 percent zoom (a 1440px layout halved to a 720x450 CSS viewport) the article kept its title with no horizontal overflow

steps.action: Discovery: the article is reachable and readable by keyboard alone
steps.actual: Arriving at the article put focus on its H1 "track-and-file-entity-obligations"; Shift+Tab reached the outline link for the filing section with a visible focus indicator (outline: solid) and Enter followed it to #mark-a-filing-and-check-the-next-cycle; the shell's "Skip to content" link was present and targets #main
